units.subject: sm
units.title: Simple Stresses and Strains
units.syllabus: Types of stresses and strains, Hooke's law, Elastic constants and their relationships, Bars of varying sections, Composite bars, Numericals based on axial loading and deformation.

units.subject: sm
units.title: Shear Force and Bending Moment
units.syllabus: Types of beams and loads, Shear force and bending moment diagrams, Relationship between load, shear force and bending moment, Point loads, UDL, UVL and moments, Numericals on SFD and BMD.

units.subject: sm
units.title: Bending and Shear Stresses in Beams
units.syllabus: Theory of simple bending, Bending equation, Section modulus, Moment of resistance, different types of beams, Shear stress distribution in beams, Rectangular, circular and I-sections, Numericals on bending and shear stresses.

units.subject: sm
units.title: Torsion, Deflection of Beams and Columns
units.syllabus: Torsion, Torsion equation, Power transmission through shafts, Solid and hollow shafts, Composite shafts, Deflection of Beams, Double integration method, Macaulay's method, Slope and deflection calculations, Numericals on shafts, beam deflections and columns.

units.subject: sm
units.title: Thin Cylinders and Combined Stresses
units.syllabus: Thin Pressure Vessels, Hoop stress, Longitudinal stress, Volumetric strain, Thin spherical shells, Combined Stresses, Principal stresses and strains, Maximum shear stress, Mohr's circle for stress, Engineering applications and numerical problems.

units.subject: te
units.title: Fundamentals and Zeroth Law of Thermodynamics
units.syllabus: Macroscopic and microscopic approaches; Thermodynamic system, surroundings and boundary; Closed, open and isolated systems; Control volume; Thermodynamic properties; Intensive and extensive properties; State, path, process and cycle; Thermodynamic equilibrium; Quasi-static process; Temperature and temperature scales; Thermal equilibrium; Zeroth Law of Thermodynamics; Thermodynamic work; Heat transfer; Specific heats; Forms of energy.

units.subject: te
units.title: First Law of Thermodynamics
units.syllabus: First Law of Thermodynamics for closed systems; Energy as a property; Internal energy; Enthalpy; First Law for cyclic and non-cyclic processes; Steady Flow Energy Equation (SFEE); Applications of SFEE to nozzles, diffusers, turbines, compressors, throttling devices and heat exchangers; Perpetual Motion Machine of the First Kind (PMM-I); Limitations of the First Law.

units.subject: te
units.title: Second Law of Thermodynamics and Entropy
units.syllabus: Heat engines; Refrigerators and heat pumps; Thermal efficiency; Coefficient of Performance (COP); Kelvin-Planck and Clausius statements; Equivalence of the Second Law statements; Reversible and irreversible processes; Carnot cycle and Carnot theorem; Clausius inequality; Entropy as a property; Entropy change for reversible and irreversible processes; Principle of increase of entropy; Entropy generation; Combined First and Second Law relations; Introduction to exergy.

units.subject: te
units.title: Vapour Power Cycle
units.syllabus: Properties of pure substances; Formation of steam; Steam tables; Mollier (h-s) diagram; Rankine cycle; Actual Rankine cycle; Thermal efficiency; Work ratio; Specific steam consumption; Methods of improving Rankine cycle performance - superheating, reheating and regeneration (introductory concepts); Introduction to steam turbines and condensers.

units.subject: te
units.title: Refrigeration Cycle
units.syllabus: Principles of refrigeration; Refrigeration effect; Ton of refrigeration; Coefficient of Performance (COP); Vapour Compression Refrigeration (VCR) cycle; Actual VCR cycle; Pressure-enthalpy (P-h) diagram; Refrigerants and desirable properties; Eco-friendly refrigerants; Introduction to Vapour Absorption Refrigeration (VAR) system; Domestic and industrial applications of refrigeration.

units.subject: mse
units.title: Structure of Crystalline Solids and Diffusion
units.syllabus: Fundamental concepts of Unit cell, Space lattice, Bravais space lattice, Unit cells for cubic structure & HCP, stacking of layers of atoms in cubic structure & HCP, calculations of radius, coordination number and atomic packing factor for different cubic structures. Simple Cubic, BCC, FCC and HCP structures, Crystal imperfections - point, line, surface and volume imperfections. Atomic Diffusion: Phenomenon, Fick's laws of diffusion (First and Second Law); Factors affecting diffusion.

units.subject: mse
units.title: Concepts of Stress and Strain, Fracture, Fatigue and Creep
units.syllabus: Tensile properties, true stress & strain, Hardness, Rockwell, Vickers & Brinell hardness testing. Plastic deformation - Slip & Twinning. Fracture: types, stages in cup & cone fracture, Griffith's criterion. Failure of materials: mechanism of fatigue, fatigue properties, S-N diagram, fatigue testing. Creep: description of the phenomenon with examples, three stages of creep, creep properties, stress relaxation. Concept of fracture toughness, numerical on diffusion, strain and stress relaxation. Alloys, Steels, Solidification.

units.subject: mse
units.title: Engineering Materials and Composites
units.syllabus: Ferrous and non-ferrous materials; Properties, Composition and uses of Grey cast iron, malleable iron, SG iron and steel; Copper alloys - brasses and bronzes; Aluminium alloys - Al-Cu, Al-Si, Al-Zn alloys; Titanium alloys. Composite Materials: Definition, classification, types of matrix materials & reinforcements, fundamentals of production of FRPs and MMCs, advantages and applications of composites.

units.subject: mse
units.title: Heat Treatment
units.syllabus: Heat treating of metals: TTT curves, CCT curves; Annealing: recovery, recrystallisation and grain growth; Types of annealing, Normalising, Hardening, Tempering, Martempering, Austempering; Concept of hardenability, factors affecting hardenability. Surface hardening methods: carburising, cyaniding, nitriding, flame hardening and induction hardening; Age hardening of Al-Cu alloys and PH steels. Ferrous materials: properties, compositions and uses of grey cast iron and steel.

units.subject: mse
units.title: Solid Solutions and Phase Diagrams
units.syllabus: Solid solutions - types, rules governing the formation of solid solutions. Phase diagrams - basic terms, phase rule, cooling curves, construction of phase diagrams, interpretation of equilibrium diagrams, types of phase diagrams, lever rule. Iron-carbon equilibrium diagram: phases in the Fe-C system, invariant reactions, critical temperatures, microstructure of slowly cooled steels, effect of alloying elements on the Fe-C diagram, ferrite & austenite stabilisers. TTT diagram for hypo- & hyper-eutectoid steels, effect of alloying elements, CCT diagram.

units.subject: mt
units.title: Casting Processes and Melting Furnaces
units.syllabus: Definition, Classification of Manufacturing Processes. Metals cast in the foundry - classification, factors that determine the selection of a casting alloy. Casting & Melting Furnaces. Die Casting: Hot chamber and cold chamber die casting, low pressure die casting, centrifugal casting, squeeze casting, and continuous casting processes. Advantages & limitations of casting process.

units.subject: mt
units.title: Metal Forming Processes
units.syllabus: Nature of plastic deformation, hot working & cold working of metals. Rolling: principle, rolling stand arrangement, rolling defects. Forging: forging operations, forging types - smith forging, drop forging & press forging, forging defects. Extrusion: extrusion principle, hot extrusion processes, cold extrusion, hydrostatic extrusion, wire drawing, rod and tube drawing.

units.subject: mt
units.title: Welding, Metal Cutting and Cutting Tools
units.syllabus: Welding classification, types of welded joints, resistance welding and gas welding. Metal cutting: introduction, chip formation, shear zone, shear angle and its significance, orthogonal and oblique cutting, mechanics of orthogonal cutting, Merchant circle diagram, numerical problems. Classification of cutting tools: single and multi-point; tool signature for single point cutting tool, cutting tool materials and applications, tool wear.

units.subject: mt
units.title: Machine Tools
units.syllabus: Introduction to basic metal cutting, basic elements of machine tools, Classification of machine tools: Lathe, Milling, Drilling, Shaping machine, Grinding.

units.subject: mt
units.title: Artificial Intelligence in Welding
units.syllabus: Introduction to AI in welding, sensors and data acquisition in welding processes, AI-based defect detection, predictive maintenance of welding equipment using AI, digital twin technology for welding process optimisation, intelligent robotic welding systems, industrial case studies on AI-enabled welding automation.
